purpose: Reviewable source contract for every broker-observed scenario required by IB PAPER qualification. The executable verifier remains authoritative and tests require exact agreement with this file.

scenarios.objective: Establish a real PAPER connection and complete the authoritative account, position and open-order barriers before mutation admission.
Demonstrate that disconnect blocks risk increase, creates a new connection epoch and requires reconciliation before reopening authority.
Observe a genuine partial fill, preserve remaining quantity and converge to an authoritative terminal result.
Prove duplicate callbacks are idempotent and out-of-order broker state is rejected or reconciled without manufacturing economic events.
Observe a real broker rejection, persist the rejection evidence and prove the rejected order is not left active.
Reject risk increase from stale authoritative market data before any place send attempt occurs.
Force a possibly-sent outcome into durable uncertainty, prohibit blind retry and resolve it through authoritative evidence.
Exercise fill/cancel races and prove the terminal projection converges without duplicate cancellation effects.
Introduce journal-versus-broker divergence, block risk increase and resolve or terminally contain the divergence.
Reject stale execution leases, accept the active lease and prove no stale owner can reach a venue send.
Observe the engaged operator kill switch, block risk increase and retain only bounded guarded exit behavior.
Restart the process, replay the durable journal, reconcile broker state and prove no duplicate risk increase occurs.
